text:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's engineering office hours — I promised to capture the unresolved runtime questions here so leadership can assign owners. Drop short replies or :thumbsup: if you want to take an action.

Kai: Thanks Sam — appreciate the write-up. I'll take point on making sure kernel priorities are clearer in the roadmap. Can someone paste the three highest-priority asks?

Maya: From runtime team side: 1) clarify kernel rollout cadence (v3 -> v4), 2) KV cache eviction policy changes that impacted 2% tail latency in last canary, 3) batching defaults for chat endpoints (we saw 20% cost delta).

Devon: Also ops flagged: lack of an automated canary rollback signal for latency regressions. We had to manually revert last night.

Priya: Product asked for an explicit SLO tradeoff doc that links batching/quantization knobs to UX regressions — e.g., user-visible hallucination rates vs token-cost. Not blocking, but helpful for prioritization.

Liam: Can we get a short explainer on why the new kernel increased worst-case KV lookup time? I captured some traces but need a TL;DR for PMs.

Maya: Short TL;DR: new kernel reduces per-token compute for long sequences by ~30% on avg, but it reorganizes KV layout which increases occasional cache misses on small-batch, short-seq workloads — those misses hit a fallback path causing the tail spikes. We're working on a micro-op to avoid fallback in the common short-seq path.

Kai: Good. For owners: Maya to own kernel rollout cadence doc; Devon to own canary rollback automation; Priya to draft SLO tradeoff doc with eng support; Liam to work with Maya on the KV tail explanation for PMs. Please ack.

Maya: Ack. I'll upload the rollout cadence draft to the runtime roadmap board by EOD Tue.

Devon: Ack. I'll prototype a latency-sla canary check and wire it to the deploy bot. Basic rule: if p99 latency increases by >10% vs baseline or absolute p99 > 120ms for 5m, auto-fail the canary. Thoughts?

Kai: That threshold sounds reasonable as a start. Add a smoothing window so noisy spikes don't trigger false positives. Also include a manual override checkbox for infra leads.

Priya: I'll draft the SLO tradeoff doc — will need input from Maya on quantization profiles and from ML ops on evaluation prompts. Expect first pass Fri.

ops-bot: @deploy-bot logged canary failure for kernel-v4-canary at 2427950000 — reverted to kernel-v3. Details: p99=142ms, baseline p99=110ms.

Sam: Thanks all. Two small asks before we close: (a) please post short links to the cadence doc and SLO tradeoff doc in this thread once up, (b) if anyone needs discussion time, let's schedule a 30m sync next week (Wednesday preferred).

Liam: I'll sync with Maya tomorrow and paste a 1-paragraph explainers for PMs here. If anyone has specific traces they want included, ping me.

Maya: Adding traces and a short microbenchmark to the rollout doc. Example config we're testing: ```
kernel_rollout: v4
canary_window_mins: 30
p99_auto_fail_pct: 10
short_seq_optim: true
```

Devon: Scheduling 30m ops-runbook review Wed 10:30am — will invite runtime + infra.

Kai: Great progress. If no objections, we'll hold leadership review next Monday to sign off on rollout cadence and canary automation.

Sam: No objections from me. Final: thumbs up emoji = you're taking the action. If you can't do it, reply with timing.

Maya: :thumbsup:

Devon: :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup:

Kai: :thumbsup:

Sam: Filed — thanks everyone.
